data.title: $1B liquidated from crypto market as Bitcoin, Ethereum drop
data.description: Crypto traders who bet on higher prices just had a very expensive couple of days.More than $1 billion in leveraged positions were liquidated as Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana all fell below key price levels.
